analysis: saved terminal plans; no solver rerun and no repair-step causal trace
limits: Intertask gaps include all non-task intervals and are not labelled as causal rail waits.
Final minimum-start constraints and iteration counts do not record rejected repair trials.
Rail gaps use point-centre x trajectories and declared stationary holds, not crane body separation.
Release slack describes saved occupancies, not performance after conservative redecoding.
Witnesses are selected same-candidate successes, not random independent cases.
